description: This file defines the generic TopicData class, which manages a set of subscribers (represented as ActorRef objects) for a specific topic, along with associated hash values. It includes methods to add and remove subscribers, check if there are any subscribers, retrieve hash information, and export the subscriber set.

classes.name: TopicData
classes.description: A thread-unsafe, final generic class that maintains a set of subscriber references and topic hashes. It provides methods to manage subscribers and access hash information.

methods.name: firstSubscriber
methods.description: Creates a new TopicData instance with the first subscriber and provided topic hashes.

methods.name: addSubscriber
methods.description: Adds a new subscriber to the set. Returns true if the set changed.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the set. Returns true if the set changed.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no subscribers.

methods.name: getHashes
methods.description: Returns the hashes associated with the topic.

methods.name: streamSubscribers
methods.description: Provides a stream of subscribers for processing.

methods.name: exportSubscribers
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable copy of the subscribers set.
